moved.sentence: Recording duration as a gauge or average instead of a histogram (loses percentiles).

judged.note: should-not-record-duration-as-gauge turns the anti-pattern into a SHOULD NOT and keeps the histogram alternative and the lost-percentiles reason.

moved.sentence: High-cardinality labels that explode the time-series count and cost.

judged.note: should-not-use-high-cardinality-labels turns the anti-pattern into a SHOULD NOT and keeps the time-series-count and cost reason.

moved.sentence: Tracking utilization while ignoring saturation, then being surprised by latency cliffs.

judged.note: should-not-track-utilization-without-saturation turns the anti-pattern into a SHOULD NOT and keeps the latency-cliff consequence.

moved.sentence: **resource-coverage**: Resources that can become a bottleneck **SHOULD** be monitored with all three USE dimensions; saturation is the most predictive of impending failure and **MUST NOT** be silently omitted.

judged.note: resource-coverage keeps the SHOULD to monitor bottleneck-capable resources on all three USE dimensions; must-not-omit-saturation keeps the predictive reason and the MUST NOT on silently omitting saturation.
